title: Calibrate a piecewise linear sensor
prompt: Implement solve(payload) with calibration points [[x,y],...] and a queries list. Return {"values":[...]} in query order. Between adjacent points interpolate linearly using that interval's slope. Clamp queries below/above the domain to the corresponding endpoint y; endpoints return their y exactly. A query is not an instruction to extrapolate. Return {"error":"too_few_points"} for fewer than two points; otherwise return {"error":"x_order"} unless x values are strictly increasing in supplied order. Empty queries return an empty values list. All numeric values are finite, pair shapes are valid, and inputs must not be mutated. Absolute/relative tolerance 1e-8.
